document_title: Process Characterization Master Plan — A-Mab Drug Substance
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
AcceptanceCriterionRecord (new) — step acceptance criteria tagged with the revision that applied them and whether they are in force or superseded
out_of_schema_notes: The master plan spans the whole train: entities are the Step 3-10 process steps, the CQA register, every parameter of the train with the class its report assigned, the instrumented scale-down systems and the method validations of the package.

acceptance_criteria holds one in-force Version 2.0 record per row of the intermediate acceptance criteria table (the plan prints no criteria-change table), plus the one Version 1.0 limit the plan states, the cation exchange aggregate limit, as superseded. Two in-force records are tightened values; their a-priori values are stated in prose and were never in force, so they have no record.

Studies are every chronology row of a schema study type. Hold studies, the method comparability study S-CEX-FRC, the nrCE-SDS retests and the invalidated first anion exchange execution S-AEX-SUP have no StudyDesign.study_type and are left out.
The campaign thresholds for model adequacy and capability, the decision statistics and the classification rules have no schema field; they are report_sections statements.
The size-variant methods table anchors the SEC (AMV-3011) and nrCE-SDS (AMV-3020) method records on the rows that name each method and occur once in the document.
No rhetorical_spans: the Version 1.0 annex carried none for the master plan, and none were curated for Version 2.0. weak_claims is empty.

statements.statement_text: PCMP-001 governs the Stage 1 process characterization of the A-Mab drug substance process, under the Process Transfer Plan PTP-001.

source_references.quote: This plan governs the Stage 1 process characterization of the A-Mab drug substance process.

statements.statement_text: Each step plan, PCP-003 to PCP-010, applies the master plan to one step and should state any departure from it with the reason.

source_references.quote: Each Process Characterization Plan (PCP-003 to PCP-010) applies this framework to one step.

statements.statement_text: Version 1.0 of the master plan defined no criteria for step outputs; Version 2.0 is issued under INV-001.

source_references.quote: Version 1.0 of this plan defined no criteria for step outputs.

statements.statement_text: Version 2.0 defines intermediate acceptance criteria for the step outputs by one rule that uses no data from the studies it judges, as the corrective action for INV-001 findings 1 to 3.

source_references.quote: This is the corrective action for INV-001 findings 1 to 3.

statements.statement_text: Version 2.0 sets nrCE-SDS as the method for fragments at every step.

source_references.quote: One method across the train is needed because a fragment balance across steps cannot mix two methods.

statements.statement_text: The screening model identifies effects, and the response-surface model is the predictive model from which every prediction, PAR and design space in the package comes.

source_references.section_title: Models, and what each model is for
heading_path: Models, and what each model is for
source_references.quote: Every prediction, every PAR and every design space in the package comes from it.

statements.statement_text: No report should claim prediction from a screening model.

source_references.section_title: Models, and what each model is for
heading_path: Models, and what each model is for
source_references.quote: No report should claim prediction from a screening model.

statements.statement_text: The decision statistic is the 95 % predictive interval of a single batch for a quality attribute and the 2.5th percentile of the mean log reduction for viral clearance.

source_references.quote: For viral clearance it is the 2.5th percentile of the mean log reduction, without the residual.

statements.statement_text: The NOR-propagated PAR is the one that supports a claim, and a PAR is never extended beyond the characterized range.

source_references.quote: A PAR is never extended beyond the characterized range.

statements.statement_text: Each drug substance criterion is carried backward through the train using the platform worst case of each downstream step, with no margin applied.

source_references.quote: For a step that adds to an attribute, it is the largest increase observed.

statements.statement_text: Of the 7 platform worst cases that could be checked, 6 were confirmed and 1 was not: cation exchange cleared aggregate 1.51-fold against a platform worst case of 2.00-fold, which tightened 2 aggregate criteria upstream of it.

source_references.section_title: Verification of the platform worst cases
heading_path: Verification of the platform worst cases
source_references.quote: Of those 7, 6 were confirmed and 1 was not.

statements.statement_text: Data may tighten a criterion and may never loosen it.

source_references.section_title: Verification of the platform worst cases
heading_path: Verification of the platform worst cases
source_references.quote: Data may tighten a criterion and may never loosen it.

statements.statement_text: The viral clearance claims meet the cumulative requirements with little room, so a step that falls short of its claim cannot be offset by another step.

source_references.quote: A step that falls short of its claim therefore cannot be offset by the surplus of another step.

statements.statement_text: A Cpk of at least 1.33 is expected of a CQA in routine manufacture, and a CQA below 1 needs an action in the control strategy.

statements.statement_text: Acidic variants have a two-sided criterion, and their capability is assessed against both ends.

statements.statement_text: A step plan is approved before the first characterization run of its step, and PCMP-001 is consolidated by PCMR-001, which is written last.
